propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete (EOF on stdin at confirmation prompt) is counted as applied success, inflating links_applied to equal cancellation count per ticket, reporting error=None with fabricated work

No exception handler print on CalledProcessError arm means failures leave only ACLI stderr trace, bypassing update_one: ... failed logs and rendering silent-noop canary ineffective (computed>0 and applied==0 check fails when applied is inflated)
Root cause is deterministic: acli 1.3.19-stable link subcommands prompt for confirmation by default and lack --yes flag, identical to bug 3256 already fixed in workitem delete

Idempotent narrowing of CalledProcessError handler must check both stderr and stdout streams for 404/409/not-found markers (matching acli.py:739 precedent), since link delete runs without --json and failure output is human-readable
Adding links_failed counter and printing it in batch_outcome allows canary to detect non-idempotent failures, completing silent-divergence detection
